definitions.explanation: The fin located on the back of a fish or marine animal. Also written as {背鰭|せびれ} with kanji. The dorsal fin helps with stability and, in some species, serves as a defense mechanism.

examples.japanese: サメ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背|せ}びれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A shark's dorsal fin was visible above the water.
This fish has venom in its dorsal fin.

examples.japanese: イルカ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背|せ}びれ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{個体|こたい}→個体：04028_kotai⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異|こと}なり→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧、⟦{識別|しきべつ}→識別：06785_shikibetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The shape of a dolphin's dorsal fin differs by individual and is used for identification.

notes:
Also written with kanji as {背鰭|せびれ}, though the hiragana form {背|せ}びれ is more common in general writing since ⟦{鰭|ひれ}→鰭：29997_hire⟧ is an uncommon kanji. Part of a set of fin terms using ～ひれ/～びれ.

RELATED FIN TERMS:
- {胸|むな}びれ: pectoral fin
- {腹|はら}びれ: pelvic/ventral fin
- ⟦{尾|お}びれ→尾びれ：24709_obire⟧: caudal/tail fin
- ⟦{尻|しり}→尻：03684_shiri⟧びれ: anal fin

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背|せ}びれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: the dorsal fin stands up
- {背|せ}びれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to spread the dorsal fin
- {背|せ}びれ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棘|とげ}→棘：13134_toge⟧: dorsal fin spine
